reviews.text: 有点逆天单局游戏时长这么长的游戏没有存档功能，而且不理解每局游戏开头那几场战斗有什么意义，开局那几场战斗基本上没有什么选择的余地你不如直接做个选项让玩家跳过也算是省时间了
说实话是因为demo的画风看起来不错才买的，对这个价格来说内容有点太少了，深度也很一般
刚玩了下，只能说像是没测试过数值的游戏，别的不提，刷新商店、扩展槽位都得花10金币买，更觉得是什么，是买了槽位，商店就自动关闭，得下次打完怪才能进商店买随从，这是人设计的？更绝得是花一个血买一个许愿机可以许愿你需要的类型随从和饰品，结果你猜怎么着，许愿出来你还得花正常的价钱去购买这个随从？？？这TM什么脑瘫的设计？？？

Seems really low effort and bland. I got tired of it long before the return window expired. Also, no cloud saves for a game with meta-progression? This release version feels very much like a beta in early access.
烂到爆炸的数值 浅到发指的深度 少到可怜的内容

Replayability after the first 20+ hours become a race to rebuild the same hand over and over again. Once you get the perfect hand you have to avoid certain traits from the enemy and that is pure random. losing 2 core life in endless mode is really pissing me off... Dont know where to go with this game anymore... ! Hard for me to recommend this game anymore. Update: Tried to replay game after a few month off. Seems like no real improvements have been made, also looks like a game save wipe has happened, so I had to start all over again... going back on the shelf again.
内容太少了，boss战连个专属音乐都没有，氛围感这块给卡住了。
风格不错我很喜欢，但是肉鸽玩起来太单一，一回合居然只有一次操作机会，购买一个随从后就不能购买其他以及进行强化导致赚费也没法花，三连合成不是底层机制还需要额外费用，构筑上限太低爽不起来，即便天胡赢了也感觉便秘一样

在推荐与不推荐之间，选择了不推荐 就目前游戏的完成度和流程只值10块，通关流程只需要40分钟 游戏的氛围不错，但是核心内容太少，而且作者似乎犯了游戏制作的一些通用毛病，闭门造车 这是一个数值游戏，所谓难度增加就是怪物的数值不停增强，玩家通过调整自己阵容最终看能走到哪 整个游戏唯一提升的手段就是商店购物，但是这个商店购物设计的反人类 我们看看他是怎么设计的： 商店进入一次只能购买一个物品，然后就又回到了战斗环节 商店不可刷新，只能同时锁定一个物品，只能买，不能卖物品 金钱有上限20元，超过不累计 商店物品的价值和你的当前持有的金钱相关，比如你就一块钱，他不会出现高级商品 所以大家想的自由组合BD去尝试不同阵容，是不存在的，TMD商店设计成这个鸟样子，只能随机去组阵容了 所以这种数值游戏，难度就是通过刁难玩家，让玩家难以养成想要的BD来提高难度 另外游戏通关后什么圣物模式，作者怕是不知道玩家玩这种游戏是追求的爽感，而不是难度把？ 你的难度通过给怪啦数值就可以体现了，还非要搞这种很恶心的东西 总之游戏都是负反馈，很少正反馈，反正40分钟就能通关，各位可以自己尝试是否好玩

Was interesting for the first few hours, but then I got bored when I realised the progression was extremely slow and grindy. Can't be bothered playing anymore. Also, their are a lot of terms and concepts in the game that are not explained whatsoever and mechanisms that don't work as they should.

I found it very difficult to enjoy this game after the tutorial. As a veteran auto-battler enjoyer, the methods of unit scaling in this game feel very obtuse and stingy and as a result turn-to-turn build progress just does not feel satisfying. The economy of the game is quite confusing. Having no rerolls in the shop turned on by default and limiting the player to one purchase per shop visit is a big deviation from a pretty established trope of the genre. Not that it's inherently bad design, but I question why the designer wanted this in conjunction with a system that encourages you to build up economy and for you to buy units for the sole purpose of buffing your other units (which, again, you can do once per shop). I just feel constantly unable to gain power or have much agency over my build. I think the game would benefit greatly from having a "bench" so that the option of pivoting your build is more realistic and your units won't vaporize when they are replaced. Otherwise, in many cases, I will feel stuck with the unit I started to permanently scale and at greater mercy of shop RNG. Once you have a build direction there is just huge potential to see a dead shop that does absolutely nothing for you. Maybe the intent is for you to build up faith for a bigger purchase down the road? But then you are just sitting on a bunch of currency and can only buy one unit per shop while your board does not gain any strength. The opportunity cost of building economy is just too high because you can't capitalize immediately on your savings. It just feels super bad. Other more minor complaints: No mid-run saving feels inexcusable. The dialogue reads like it was generated by ChatGPT. Overall I just can't recommend this game.
今年玩过种类玩法最为丰富的自走牌类型的游戏了，职业很多，流派可选择的也很多，强烈推荐给竞技类游戏玩累的群体们。

It's hard to recommend the game with how slow the animations are even at 3x speed. The atmosphere is amazing in first few runs, but after that it feels that you are spending most of your time just waiting for the transition animations to play out. The high RNG shop combined with +3 corruption just exacerbates the problem, when few bad early shops makes you want to restart the run. And this is even after the transition speed update.
It's actually a fun game, but a bit too simplistic.

I really liked the demo, the art, the atmosphere, and enjoyed the gameplay. I purchased the game. I am refunding unfortunately for two reasons. No game save, and dev says this may not be too dificult to implement. The other reason is I am not sure how much variation/content. I wish the developers well and will check in again in the future to see how things are because this is a good foundation of a game.

对美术、文风和黑暗奇幻题材感兴趣入手的，以前基本没玩过自走棋，但玩过很多肉鸽打牌游戏。 我认为这游戏出彩的点在于剧情、美术、氛围风格等等，本身玩法属于中规中矩的自走棋类型，但有几点可能会导致游戏过程中感到受挫/爽感夹断： 1.商店操作受限。我认为这是最大的问题，在金钱有上限的前提下每个商店（也就是招募事件）中只能进行一次购买操作，这可以说直接杜绝了一波运营逆天翻盘的可能性，被滚雪球直接去世的可能性非常大；此外，不自带刷新功能、每轮只能锁定一件物品以及消耗核心生命的许愿事件依旧需要花钱买这几点也是导致体验不佳的重要因素。 2.没有存档功能。作为一局普遍20分钟往上的游戏居然没有存档，不打完或者放弃甚至连退出游戏都做不到（没试过Alt+F4不知道是什么效果）。不说sl可以改操作啥的，至少我在打无尽有事要离开一会儿想回来接着打得给我个保存键吧。现在属于是一把不结束给你锁死在电脑前面。 3.收藏家淬炼随从获取需要占用三个招募轮次。还是之前说的商店操作受限问题，由于淬炼随从需要购买两个相同随从加后续商店再购买一次淬炼随从，相当于需要花费三个商店轮次也就是大于等于六深度的发育时间。这对于阵容构筑的强度影响非常大，即使不算在这三场战斗期间的战损，由于中后期敌人成长往往快于单纯添加一名白板随从的强度增长，因此也很有可能出现“商店碰到并购买某个随从→第一战勉强过关→买到第二个相同的随从→核心生命-1→获得淬炼随从→已经打不过了然后被滚雪球”的情况。 4.许愿池事件。消耗1核心生命定向获取某随从或者性相，问题一是许愿出来后依旧需要原价购买，二是许愿过程中选项描述过于谜语人有时候即使有想要的目标也会选错，希望可以再多一些引导或者描述。 5.一些性相效果太不智能。例如“死亡时给身后一个随从+2生命”这个词条，严格按照身后第一个随从来执行，即使那个随从已经死了，这个加生命的效果作用在了尸体上然后无事发生，类似的情况还有不少，这可能是机制设计或者编码可能不够严谨的部分。 目前大概就这些想法，我也不是什么资深玩家。只是出于希望能够有更好的游戏体验的初衷想给工作室提一点微薄的拙见，也给想了解这个游戏的玩家提供一点借鉴。 虽然建议提了不少，但我认为还是本游还是值得推荐的。希望能够持续更新，蒸蒸日上，游戏底子很好，我想更爽一点:)
游戏流程存在严重硬伤，层数的难度曲线设置及其不合理 每回合只能购买一次，刷新功能需要购买遗物道具解锁，这又占用一个回合，敌人回合直接入你，数值超级膨胀，你每局只能祈祷你能早点遇到能组合combo的牌，几乎不存在打工随从的说法，经济系统也是一坨 爽局可以相当爽，但十把成不了一把爽局
to oversimplify, it's cosmic grimdark super auto pets. cool aesthetic, decent build variety, and 10-20 hours worth of content for a reasonable level of completion.
游戏还是很好玩的，6个多小时基本解锁了所有流派，并通关了一次，适合闲暇之余开一把高难，但作为一款卡牌游戏，缺少稀有卡牌的收集要素，如果boss打完后能作为卡组加入的话，就更好了

我在圣骸匣模式的无尽模式中被无尽艳阳给恶心到了，因为我选了战斗中，只有首位和末位才能攻击，这个buff一定要我把随从放1号位和8号位，就算1号位死亡2号位也没办法进行攻击。然而这个无尽艳阳的效果是：战斗开始前，首位和末位的随从的效果会失效，直接变成白板。导致我每次遇到这个怪就必定会扣血，完全看不懂为什么在被限制的条件又设计这种遇见就必输的怪？本来内容就很少，还没打几种圣骸匣就被恶心..... 除去白板，其实就三种有特色的模式，基本上玩个2-3小时就能玩完。其中就养虫能爽，另外两个爽不起来，特别是合成这个我是很喜欢的，但限制13导致只能合成低级和中级的怪，导致ban掉了很多组合，非常不爽，合来合去都是这些低级怪 好玩是好玩的，但内容匮乏，只能当个小游戏玩，不推荐入手

Its a great game with a really good gameplay loop, but the difficulty scaling prestige system (think like ascension in slay the spire) is really bad, which wouldn't be a big issue if the game wasn't really easy. Okay so you're basically guaranteed to win in your first 3 tries. Then you unlock the reliquary that gives 3 randomized modified-run options, BUT you can just reroll this as many times as you want, making the randomization pointless. They probably added the reroll option because a lot of the random modifiers just don't work together or are just really unfun. So let's say you play the reliquary randomized runs anyways because you want to be challenged a little when you play the game. There's three unlocks in the whole game, for the 3 extra characters. I'm not saying your game has to have meta-progression, I'm just saying there should be something to strive for. Slay the Spire is a great example again, beating the game on ascension 10 doesn't do anything except unlock ascension 11, but each level of ascension is something to strive for. This game just doesn't have anything to strive for. I've played 2 and a half hours and there's nothing more to do. I really wish I could play more but its either too easy or I'm playing with randomizers that are more annoying than challenging and feel completely arbitrary.
This is just a puzzle. Click numbers until you get the right numbers. It's just a rubix cube with barebone graphics.

[h3]《无境空界》是一款卡牌肉鸽游戏，美术和音乐都很出色。[/h3] 《无境空界》在视觉和听觉上堪称惊艳，暗黑童话般的美术风格与沉浸感极强的音乐，共同构筑了一个令人过目不忘的独特世界。它的卡牌设计颇具巧思，许多卡面效果和角色设定都充满了让人眼前一亮的新意，为构建各种打法提供了有趣的种子。游戏在基础框架上展现出了扎实的潜力，对于喜爱独特风格，愿意深入琢磨的玩家而言，它提供了一个值得驻足体验的精致舞台。如果制作组能持续优化和丰富内容，它的未来非常值得期待。 [h3]但也有一些设计建议调整。[/h3] [b]经济系统太死板[/b] 游戏里商店每回合只能买一次牌，金币有上限，刷新也是随机的。这让组卡变得很束手束脚，很难凑出强力套路。大部分时候只能靠稳步提升属性过关，很多有趣的流派因为前期太弱，根本玩不起来。 [b]BOSS设计不合理[/b] 有些道中BOSS明显针对某些流派。你好不容易凑齐一套牌的雏形，却碰到完全克制你的BOSS，打起来非常无力。不知道下次怎么避免，这种感觉更像运气不好，而不是策略有问题。而且无尽模式里也有某些祝福和效果组合起来几乎必输（比如首位末位攻击的祝福与“无尽艳阳”封印效果的致命组合），缺乏应对手段，基本无解。 [b]内容少，节奏拖沓[/b] 游戏玩过一两遍后就没什么新鲜感了。可用的卡牌和随从不多，路线也比较固定。战斗速度偏慢，就算开了三倍速，战斗动画与无意义的黑屏等待仍然很拖沓，这些不停地消耗着玩家的耐心。有些角色（比如蛾子）过度依赖关键牌，如果拿不到，整局都会很难打。总的来说感觉能肉鸽的部分很受限制。 [h3]总结[/h3] 《无境空界》画面和卡牌设计有潜力，但玩法目前比较生硬和单薄。它适合喜欢这种美术风格、并且有耐心反复尝试的玩家。如果制作组能调整经济系统、优化BOSS设计、增加更多内容，游戏体验应该会好很多。现在来说，它还算不上很成熟的作品。 [quote] 闲暇时光，不妨试试游戏。 欢迎关注[url=store.steampowered.com/curator/45653622/] 闲暇時光鉴赏组 [/url] [/quote]
蓝色叠层，刷到蓝色刀就锁，每消费5蓝色数值+1/+2的 买狗，买圣骑士 狗用来叠亡语+4蓝或者生存+4蓝都行 尽量全员3被动，圣骑大哥基本可以1v全部 除了一些特殊怪
游戏是不错的，很有创意的自走棋玩法，刚开始玩可能会因为没搞懂一些规则和卡牌、圣骸之间的组合而觉得无聊，但是都熟悉后反而越玩越上头，玩法流派非常多。但是缺点就是强度不平衡，强力的卡牌流派就几个，还有一个遇到就封印所有能力的Boss基本遇到了就必输，后期内容量也比较少，给个好评希望制作组能多更新和进行平衡性调整，是个很有潜力的好游戏！
我认为这是一款不可多的的非常优质的肉鸽游戏，能够选择的棋子是随机的，甚至三档难度也是随机的，每次游玩能玩出的套牌都是不同的，所以每次卡牌组合的效果和视觉呈现都不一样，我很喜欢，就是模式太少了，无尽模式100层后敌方数值膨胀的太厉害了

一个还算不错的游戏，有空可以买来玩玩~ 其他的话： 1.建议把无尽模式的快进算进常规模式，这么a来a去前面人少其实还好，后面我开场就想它结束了…… 2.如果你是因为roguelike或者期待该游戏的随机性的话，其实这个更像是酒馆战棋mini，目前的体验下来没有什么惊天大爆的成长或者逆天卡 3.目前没看到什么局外成长，感觉还行 4.圣骸匣不知道刷新不知道为啥会闪退，但是装备圣骸是直接开不用退出次级菜单这个事情做的很不错，很喜欢

本质是个魔塔 或者说换个角度看 魔塔简直就是最本质最古早的自走棋 只是放了一部分游戏设计到地图的探索与路线规划上 这边的数值怎么算呢 你小队的攻击力总和就是你的攻击力 而血的临界会导致降攻 同时吞掉单发的溢出伤害 讲道理仅仅是这个规则改动就已经可以在自动攻防博弈里做出区别了 更别提小队是有关键字的 我觉得很优秀的设计之一在于正反馈循坏拉得很好很密 打完一把就是购买 购买之后就是战斗 抛开其他所有冗余系统 只玩最纯粹的小数值攻防博弈 至于小队战后全部复活其实也只是“防御”的一个变体罢了 魔塔也是防御直接减伤 你死掉的人只要没死光就是没战损 不需要在做额外的血量管理维度了 现阶段4个角色已经很够玩了 虽然随从就那么200多种 boss的梗见几次也就知道怎么解了 整体差不多就是6h-10h左右的流程 但圣遗物的解法其实还挺有意思 我觉得稍微花点精力给每个词缀评分也是对的 至少玩家侧的传递也很能知道这个mod打上了是更难还是更简单 多打几个词缀会导致我的run出现什么变化 互斥的问题设计师也提前想到了 整体来说这是一个数值非常扎实的桌游 只不过0个人愿意手动结算每一次对撞罢了 就跟魔塔点子不难想 但实现一定得是代码一样 我可太好这口电子游戏只是辅助结算的游戏了 闪烁着机制之光 总体来说是最近玩到的最惊喜的一款游戏 9/10推荐
某些点上做了太多减法，导致bd上有些浅。此外卡牌的类型用的都是同一种卡框造成了极大的困扰。但氛围感和机设还是不错的
Very fun, Nice roguelike aspect with the cards and the shop. It'd be a great idea if you were to be able to alter decks with your own selection of cards. W game!

If you like picking from 3 things, give this a try. The vibes and the gameplay absolutely tickle my brain, great sound and interesting deck/board building mechanics. I don't think I'll play this for 1000 hours or anything, but it was great fun. Looking forward to seeing what they come up with next!
Solid autobattler

This game isn't the most replayable, but it is quite fun and the artwork and worldbuilding are absolutely phenomenal. I genuinely think it's worth the price for the card art alone. Was satisfying enough 100%ing to get all the lore nuggets.
玩了很久 每当我不知道要打开什么游戏 就打开打一把 目前还是觉得随机伤害流 比较厉害
A very fun, high quality game. I want more, I would pay for an expansion for sure.
neat game very fun to go infinite

It was quite simple at first, then once you've collected the additional starting characters - the game changes into a rather difficult relic hunt. Relics being what changes the difficulty of a run. Each can provide a very different challange. * It would have been nice for them to add a way to tell which relics you've already collected without memorizing the entire list. For around ten bucks, not bad.
its a good rpg

Holder of Place is something special, I can't really put my finger on it but I think it has something to do with the vibes. It's quite a hard auto-battler, I've lost way more times than I've won and it feels rare to stumble into a powerful build and I dunno, it's still great. One thing I can put my finger on is that I absolutely LOVE the UI design, so damn slick.
Fun solo roguelite
its aight

Great aesthetic, design and worldbuilding, nice sounds, and good gameplay loop, various build combos, what more could you ask for from a deckbuilding roguelike. And i really liked the writing, it's artsy.

Absolutely gem of a deck builder / roguelike. Very well made all around. The balance mechanics, the music and the art style. I think the devs can be really proud of this one. There's limited content to explore and that's my only real critique.

Beautiful game all around. I love the artwork, music, gameplay, and writing. I can tell they put a lot of love into fleshing out the world via journal entries and flavor text. Winning the first run unlocks the Reliquary. This gives you random modifiers for each run, which adds a ton of replayability. Highly recommend if you like deckbuilders!

Excellent atmospheric auto battler. The systems are fun to experiment with, and the difficulty is tuned to be challenging enough to spark creativity but not so punishing as to be discouraging when losing a run

The visuals and atmosphere are really interesting. The gameplay is cool, and it's incredibly satisfying when you manage to pull off an effective combo. Unfortunately, I have to leave a negative review because I lose all my save data every time I uninstall and reinstall it.
hands down the best autobattler i've played in 2026, it's stylish, plenty of variety, and random modifications pool allows to have many different run vatiations after you've completed the main course

Fantastic minimalist roguelike autobattler. Tightly designed with fun in-run progression. The only unlocks are 3 new starting recruit options which greatly change how your deck plays and reliquaries to modify difficulty, other than that there's no stats or items to unlock. Enemy and boss variety and design are all great, same goes for units and buffs. Combat is fun and fast but requires strategy because unit recruitment, buffing, and placement are massively impactful. Repeated runs feel unique with all the choices provided. There's a bit of fun worldbuilding via text as well if you're into that sort of thing. The recruit/buff options always pull from the same set but I found the set's variety kept things from feeling too repetitive especially when picking a different start unit since each one significantly changes the way things play. As long as the ascetic presentation doesn't bother you I highly recommend this game.
